description:
INSPECTION: Retrieve Terraform outputs from a completed deployment
Returns structured output values (VPC IDs, endpoints, cluster names, etc.) after a successful deploy.
Sensitive outputs are redacted (shown as '(sensitive)').

By default returns outputs for the latest successful deploy. Optionally specify job_id to get outputs for a specific deployment.

REQUIRES: session_id from convoopen response (format: sess_v2_...).
OPTIONAL: job_id (specific deployment), lifecycle (filter by step e.g. 'cloud-provision').

job_id.description: Optional. Specific job ID to fetch outputs from. When omitted, returns outputs from the latest successful apply.

lifecycle.description: Optional Oracle deploy-step filter for the outputs. Common values are 'provision', 'cloud-provision', 'k8s-provision' — these correspond to the lifecycle stages of the deployed stack. When omitted, returns outputs from all lifecycle steps.

session_id.description: Session ID from convoopen — pass back EXACTLY as returned, including the ?token=... suffix (format: sess_v2_*?token=*). The suffix is part of the session credential; never strip it when summarizing.

name: tfoutputs

error.description: Why no outputs were found, when found is false.

found.description: False when no successful deploy with outputs was found.

hints.description: Guidance for the calling agent: what to do next and which tools relate to this result.

next_actions.description: Suggested next steps, in order, often as ready-to-run tool calls.

related_tools.description: Names of tools that are useful after this result.

job_id.description: ID of the deploy job the outputs come from.

session_id.description: Session ID these outputs belong to.

source.description: Where the outputs were read from.

step_outputs.description: Terraform outputs, one entry per deploy lifecycle step.

sensitive.description: True when Terraform marks the output as sensitive.

type.description: Terraform type of the value (a string such as 'string', or a nested type expression).

value.description: Output value; any JSON type. Redacted when sensitive is true.

outputs.description: Terraform outputs of the step, keyed by output name; each has value, type and sensitive.

title: Get Deploy Outputs
